catalog.name: Tomato
catalog.description: Juicy, sun-ripened country tomatoes picked at the peak of redness. Perfect for rasam, chutneys, curries and fresh salads.
catalog.benefits: Rich in lycopene and vitamin C; supports heart and skin health.

catalog.name: Small Onion (Shallot)
catalog.description: Pungent and sweet sambar onions grown in red soil. The heart of every South Indian kitchen, from sambar to vatha kuzhambu.
catalog.benefits: Contains antioxidants and sulphur compounds that support immunity.

catalog.name: Potato
catalog.description: Firm, earthy potatoes from the cool hill farms. Great for roasts, poriyal, masala dosa filling and crispy fries.
catalog.benefits: Good source of energy, potassium and vitamin B6.

catalog.name: Carrot
catalog.description: Crunchy, sweet Ooty carrots with a deep orange colour. Lovely raw in salads, in halwa or tossed into a quick poriyal.
catalog.benefits: Packed with beta-carotene for eye health and glowing skin.

catalog.name: Brinjal
catalog.description: Tender purple brinjals with soft seeds and glossy skin. Ideal for ennai kathirikai, sambar and smoky baingan bharta.
catalog.benefits: High in fibre and low in calories; aids digestion.

catalog.name: Lady's Finger (Okra)
catalog.description: Young, tender okra that snaps cleanly. Makes a crisp vendakkai fry, a tangy puli kuzhambu or a light mor kuzhambu.
catalog.benefits: Rich in folate, vitamin K and soluble fibre.

catalog.name: Drumstick
catalog.description: Long, fleshy murungakkai straight from backyard trees. The soul of a good sambar and drumstick kootu.
catalog.benefits: Loaded with calcium, iron and vitamin C.

catalog.name: Cabbage
catalog.description: Tight, fresh green cabbage heads with crisp leaves. Use for cabbage poriyal, coleslaw or vegetable kurma.
catalog.benefits: Rich in vitamin K and C; supports gut health.

catalog.name: Cauliflower
catalog.description: Creamy white cauliflower with dense florets. Perfect for gobi 65, aloo gobi and flavourful kurma.
catalog.benefits: Good source of vitamin C, folate and choline.

catalog.name: Spinach (Keerai)
catalog.description: Freshly cut leafy greens, washed and bundled the same morning. Make keerai masiyal, palak paneer or a simple dal.
catalog.benefits: Excellent source of iron, calcium and folate.

catalog.name: Green Chilli
catalog.description: Bright, fiery green chillies with a fresh aroma. A must for tempering, chutneys and pickles.
catalog.benefits: Contains capsaicin and vitamin C; boosts metabolism.

catalog.name: Beans
catalog.description: Tender French beans without strings, snapped fresh from the vine. Great for beans poriyal, fried rice and paruppu usili.
catalog.benefits: Rich in fibre, vitamin A and plant protein.

catalog.name: Bitter Gourd
catalog.description: Firm green pavakkai with prominent ridges. Makes crispy chips, a tangy pitlai or a jaggery-balanced curry.
catalog.benefits: Known to help regulate blood sugar; rich in iron.

catalog.name: Pumpkin
catalog.description: Sweet yellow pumpkin with dense flesh. Wonderful in sambar, kootu, halwa or a creamy soup.
catalog.benefits: High in vitamin A and antioxidants; good for eyes.

catalog.name: Banana
catalog.description: Naturally ripened Poovan and Robusta bananas — no carbide. A quick, healthy snack for all ages.
catalog.benefits: Instant energy, potassium and vitamin B6.

catalog.name: Mango
catalog.description: Fragrant Alphonso and Banganapalli mangoes, tree-ripened and sweet. The king of summer fruits.
catalog.benefits: Rich in vitamins A and C; supports immunity.

catalog.name: Guava
catalog.description: Crisp, fragrant country guavas with pink and white flesh. Best enjoyed with a pinch of salt and chilli.
catalog.benefits: Has more vitamin C than oranges; high in fibre.

catalog.name: Papaya
catalog.description: Soft, orange-fleshed papayas ripened on the tree. Light on the stomach and great for breakfast.
catalog.benefits: Contains papain enzyme that aids digestion.

catalog.name: Watermelon
catalog.description: Big, juicy watermelons with sweet red flesh. The perfect cooler for hot Chennai summers.
catalog.benefits: Over 90% water; keeps you hydrated.

catalog.name: Pomegranate
catalog.description: Ruby-red Bhagwa pomegranates bursting with juicy arils. Lovely as juice, in curd rice or on salads.
catalog.benefits: Rich in antioxidants; supports heart health.

catalog.name: Sapota (Chikoo)
catalog.description: Soft, brown-skinned sapotas with a malty, caramel sweetness. Excellent in milkshakes.
catalog.benefits: Natural sugars for energy; rich in fibre.

catalog.name: Coconut
catalog.description: Mature coconuts with thick, sweet kernel from coastal groves. For chutneys, curries and fresh coconut milk.
catalog.benefits: Healthy fats and minerals; a kitchen essential.

catalog.name: Ponni Rice
catalog.description: Aged Ponni rice from Thanjavur delta farms. Soft, fluffy and aromatic — the everyday rice of Tamil Nadu.
catalog.benefits: Easily digestible source of energy.

catalog.name: Ragi (Finger Millet)
catalog.description: Stone-cleaned ragi grown without chemicals. Make ragi kali, dosa, porridge or healthy cookies.
catalog.benefits: Very high in calcium; great for bones and diabetics.

catalog.name: Toor Dal
catalog.description: Unpolished toor dal that cooks soft and creamy. The base of sambar, paruppu and dal tadka.
catalog.benefits: Good source of plant protein and folic acid.

catalog.name: Groundnut
catalog.description: Bold, freshly harvested groundnuts. Roast them, boil them or grind into chutney and oil.
catalog.benefits: Healthy fats, protein and vitamin E.

catalog.name: Country Eggs
catalog.description: Nattu kozhi eggs from free-range hens raised in the backyard. Richer yolk, better taste.
catalog.benefits: Complete protein with essential vitamins.

catalog.name: Fresh Milk
catalog.description: Pure cow's milk delivered fresh every morning from village dairies. No preservatives, no dilution.
catalog.benefits: Calcium and protein for strong bones.

catalog.name: Wild Honey
catalog.description: Raw forest honey collected from hill-region hives. Unheated and unprocessed with a deep floral flavour.
catalog.benefits: Natural antioxidant; soothes the throat.

catalog.name: Jaggery (Vellam)
catalog.description: Chemical-free sugarcane jaggery made in traditional pans. Perfect for pongal, payasam and sweets.
catalog.benefits: Contains iron and minerals; a healthier sweetener.

reviews.comment: Soft and aromatic rice, just like my grandmother used to cook. Will buy again!
Naturally ripened and sweet. A couple were slightly bruised but overall great.
Very fresh drumsticks, made an amazing sambar.
Best mangoes I have had this season. Super sweet!
Potatoes from the hills taste so different. Excellent quality.
Sweet and crunchy carrots. Fresh like straight from the farm.

messages.name: Karthik
messages.message: Do you deliver to Porur? I would love to order vegetables weekly.
